transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because the routing system at the warehouse isn’t just a computer anymore. It’s been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, trying to push me out because I’m one of the old hands.
About how long have you been noticing this happening with the routing system?
About a year and eight months now. That’s when I first started noticing the scanners and the voices tied to them.
Have you used any recreational drugs or non-prescribed substances during this time?
I’m not sure what you mean by non-prescribed substances. I haven’t really noticed anything like that being part of this.
Could you tell me more about the voices you hear?
Even when I’m sitting in my garage and everything’s shut off, I hear dispatch voices clear as day. They call my operator number and say I’m dangerous, or that security’s coming for me.
Have you been diagnosed with any physical medical or neurological conditions?
Not that I know of. I haven’t been told I have any medical or neurological condition.
During this past year and a half, have you experienced periods where you felt deeply depressed or hopeless most of the time?
Yeah. It’s been hanging over me for about two years and a month now—started not long after the schedule change began wearing me down.
Have there ever been periods where you heard the voices or noticed the messages from the scanners, but were not feeling depressed?

Yes. There was a stretch where my mood had eased up some—I was eating and talking a little more—but I still heard dispatch calling my number for several weeks. I still believed the routing system was tracking me.
